object.attr: derived: CF-S1. A partial clone isn't shallow, so it passes the root check, but Mellon can't fetch its missing folders and file contents; history, Compare and merge then fail, and a failed suspect scan shows links as OK (E28). Decided on 2026-11-10 (Q-S13).
object.description: If the repository in the folder Mellon is asked to open is a partial clone, Mellon shall refuse the folder.
